_description: LGC_VRCMAFury_中文拓展 2.3.6；已适配 VRCFury 1.1485.0，补充 SPS 引导路径和常用新增界面文字。

entries.key: If you are trying to override a finger collider, you should use a VRCFury Global Collider component instead! It will automatically select an appropriate available finger, and can be used within prefabs.
entries.value: 如果要覆盖手指碰撞体，请使用 VRCFury 全局碰撞体组件！它会自动选择合适的可用手指，也可用于预制件。

entries.key: This feature will set the anchor override for every mesh on your avatar to your chest. This will prevent different meshes from being lit differently on your body.
entries.value: 将角色所有网格的光照锚点覆盖设置为胸部，避免身体各部分的网格受到不同的光照。

entries.key: The following actions will be applied and baked into to the avatar during the upload process. This is useful if you want to enforce a specific upload state of your prop, even if the user has messed with it in the editor.
entries.value: 上传时将以下动作应用并烘焙到角色中。即使用户在编辑器中改动了道具，也能确保它以指定状态上传。

entries.key: Note: 'Turn On' toggles automatically turn off their objects during upload, and thus do not need to be included here.
entries.value: 注意：“开启”类开关会在上传时自动关闭对应对象，无需在此重复设置。

entries.key: This feature will attach a prop (with or without an armature) to the avatar. If 'Link From' is an armature matching the avatar's, the armatures will be merged and the extra bones will not count toward performance rank.
entries.value: 将带骨架或不带骨架的道具连接到角色上。如果来源骨架与角色骨架匹配，会合并两者；合并掉的额外骨骼不会计入性能评级。

entries.key:
For clothing, this should be the Hips bone in the clothing's Armature (or the 'main' bone if it doesn't have Hips).
For non-clothing objects (things that you just want to re-parent), this should be the object you want moved.
entries.value:
服装请选择服装骨架中的 Hips 骨骼；没有 Hips 时，选择主骨骼。
普通道具请选择需要更改父级的对象。

entries.key: Adds another target to try if earlier targets aren't found. Bone targets already automatically fall back to similar bones if the exact bone isn't found.
entries.value: 前面的目标未找到时，尝试下一个备用目标。骨骼目标在找不到精确匹配时，已经会自动尝试相近骨骼。

entries.key: Shows an Offset Path field for each target, letting you select a child relative to the chosen bone or object. Most setups don't need an offset.
entries.value: 为各个目标显示偏移路径，以便选择相对于目标骨骼或对象的子级。多数设置无需偏移。

entries.key: If enabled, child objects with matching object names on the avatar will also be linked
entries.value: 同时连接角色上名称相同的子对象。

entries.key: If set, this substring will be ignored when matching object names against the avatar. This is useful for props where the artist added something like _PropName to the end of every bone. If empty, the suffix will be predicted based on the difference between the name of the given root bones.
entries.value: 匹配角色对象名称时忽略指定字符串，适用于作者为所有骨骼添加了 _PropName 等后缀的道具。留空时，根据两个根骨骼的名称差异自动推断。

entries.key: Snap merged objects to the existing transform on the avatar
entries.value: 将合并对象对齐到角色上目标对象的现有变换。
将倍率限制为 10 的整数次幂

entries.key: When checked, the scale multiplier will be set to the Link From object's world scale divided by the Link To object's world scale. When combined with 'Restrict to powers of 10', this will automatically correct for clothes which have been incorrectly exported with the wrong scale units.
entries.value: 根据连接来源与连接目标的世界缩放之比设置倍率。配合“限制为 10 的整数次幂”，可自动修正服装导出时的缩放单位错误。
修改这些选项可能导致异常，请谨慎操作。

entries.key: Remove parent constraints from merged objects
entries.value: 移除合并对象上的父级约束

entries.key: This box allows you to force the name of the object at the merged target location. This is useful if you want to forcefully merge a replacement MMD Body onto the base avatar. (Paired with Advanced Link Target Mode pointing to the avatar root). BEWARE: If you use this, offset animations and toggles for the merged object WILL NOT WORK.
entries.value: 强制设置合并目标位置上的对象名称。例如，可配合指向角色根对象的高级连接目标来合并替换用的 MMD Body。注意：启用后，合并对象的位置偏移动画和开关将无法工作。

entries.key: After linking, forces the world scale of the root object to 1,1,1.
entries.value: 连接后将根对象的世界缩放强制设为 1,1,1。

entries.key:
These clothes are designed for a different version of your avatar's rig. You may have downloaded the wrong version of the clothes for your avatar version, or the clothes may not be designed for your avatar. Contact the clothing creator, and see if they have a proper version of the clothing for your rig.

VRCFury will attempt to merge it anyways, but the affected areas may have slight clipping issues.
entries.value:
这套服装适用于另一版本的角色骨架。你可能下载了错误版本，或该服装本来就不适用于此角色。请向服装作者确认是否有匹配版本。

VRCFury 仍会尝试合并，但受影响部位可能会轻微穿模。

entries.key: It appears this object is clothing with an Armature and Hips bone. If you are trying to link the clothing to your avatar, the Link From box should be the Hips object from this clothing, not this main object!
entries.value: 此对象看起来是带有 Armature 和 Hips 骨骼的服装。要将服装连接到角色，请在“连接来源”中选择服装的 Hips 对象，而非服装主对象！
未找到角色描述组件（Avatar Descriptor）

entries.key: These bones do not have a match on the avatar and will be added as new children:
entries.value: 以下骨骼在角色上没有匹配项，将作为新的子对象添加：

entries.key: This Avatar Scale feature is no longer available as scaling is now built into VRChat.
entries.value: 此功能已停用：VRChat 已内置角色缩放功能。

entries.key: This feature will link the blendshapes in the specified skinned meshes to a skinned mesh on the avatar base. The default value and any menu items controlling the blendshape will be updated to control these linked objects as well.
entries.value: 将指定蒙皮网格上的形态键与角色基础蒙皮网格上的形态键联动。形态键默认值以及控制这些形态键的菜单项，也会同步控制联动的对象。

entries.key: Name of skinned mesh object on avatar:
entries.value: 角色上基础蒙皮网格对象的名称：
联动基础网格上的所有形态键

entries.key: Link blendshapes with exact names only
entries.value: 仅联动名称完全相同的形态键
复制形态键名称到剪贴板

entries.key: Base skin could not be found

entries.value: 未找到有效的联动蒙皮网格

entries.key: This feature will automatically bake all non-animated blendshapes into the mesh, saving VRAM for free!
entries.value: 自动将没有动画控制的形态键烘焙到网格中，节省显存。

entries.key: This feature will add Blinking to your avatar. You can use this in place of blinking in the VRC Avatar Descriptor, or on a prop to add blinking to an additional object.
entries.value: 为角色添加眨眼动画，可替代角色描述组件中的眨眼功能；也可用于道具，让其他对象眨眼。

entries.key: Transition Time (in seconds, -1 will use VRCFury recommended value)
entries.value: 过渡时间（秒；-1 使用 VRCFury 推荐值）

entries.key: Hold Time - Time eyelids will remain closed (in seconds, -1 will use VRCFury recommended value)
entries.value: 闭眼停留时间（秒；-1 使用 VRCFury 推荐值）

entries.key: This feature is deprecated. Please use Armature Link instead. It can do everything this feature can do and more.
entries.value: 此功能已弃用。请改用“骨架联动”，它支持此功能的全部用途，并提供更多功能。

entries.key: Adds a parent constraint from the specified object to the specified bone. Useful for props which are packaged as VRCFury prefabs.
entries.value: 在指定对象与角色骨骼之间添加父级约束，适用于封装为 VRCFury 预制件的道具。

entries.key: This component is deprecated and now does nothing. Bounding Box Fix is now automatically enabled by default for all avatars using VRCFury.
entries.value: 此组件已弃用，不再执行任何操作。使用 VRCFury 的角色现已默认自动修复包围盒。

entries.key:
This component forces a VRC Constraint on the current object to point to affect a bone on the base avatar.

This is basically only useful for GogoLoco.
entries.value:
将当前对象上的 VRC 约束重定向到基础角色的骨骼。

此功能主要供 GogoLoco 使用。

entries.key: This feature automatically tweaks your avatar eyes so that they can't go cross-eyed in VRChat. It does this by eliminating eye bone roll through fake eye bones and rotation constraints.
entries.value: 自动调整角色眼睛以避免在 VRChat 中出现斗鸡眼。通过辅助眼骨骼和旋转约束消除眼骨骼的滚转。

entries.key: This entire object, and all children, will be deleted during upload. No other VRCFury components stored within will be processed.
entries.value: 上传时删除此对象及其所有子对象。内部的其他 VRCFury 组件也不会被处理。

entries.key: This component displays VRCFury's useful debug info about the controllers on your avatar's base avatar descriptor. This component has no impact on the avatar, and changes nothing about the upload. Any detected warnings will be shown below.
entries.value: 显示角色描述组件上动画控制器的 VRCFury 调试信息。此组件不会改变角色或上传结果；检测到的警告会显示在下方。

entries.key: This feature attempt to fix an avatar with a broken mix of Write Defaults.
entries.value: 尝试修复角色中混用 Write Defaults 导致的问题。

entries.key:
Auto - Will force all states to on or off, whichever requires the fewest changes to the existing avatar
Force On - Forces all states to WD on
Force Off - Forces all states to WD off
Disabled - Don't try to fix anything and don't warn even if it looks broken
entries.value:
自动：统一开启或关闭，以现有角色所需改动最少为准。
强制开启：将所有状态的 Write Defaults 设为开启。
强制关闭：将所有状态的 Write Defaults 设为关闭。
禁用：不进行修复，也不显示相关警告。

entries.key: Avatar base has broken mixed write defaults!
entries.value: 基础角色存在异常的 Write Defaults 混用！

entries.key: Here are the states that don't match:
entries.value: 以下状态的设置不一致：

entries.key: This feature will merge the given controller / menu / parameters into the avatar during the upload process.
entries.value: 上传时将指定的控制器、菜单和参数合并到角色中。

entries.key:
VRCFury normally renames all merged parameters so that they will never conflict with parameters already existing on the avatar / other copies of this prefab.

Parameters in this list will have their name kept as is, allowing you to interact with parameters in the avatar itself or other instances of the prop. Note that VRChat global parameters (such as gestures) are included by default.

If you want to make all parameters global, you can use enter a *

You can also make a specific prefix global by adding a * to the end: MyGlobalParams/*

If you want to make all parameters global except for a few, you can mark specific parameters as not global by prefixing them with a !
entries.value:
VRCFury 通常会重命名合并的参数，避免与角色现有参数或同一预制件的其他副本冲突。

此列表中的参数将保留原名，可用于与角色本身或其他道具实例交互。VRChat 内置全局参数（例如手势）默认已包含。

输入 * 可将全部参数设为全局参数。

可在前缀后添加 *，例如 MyGlobalParams/*，将该前缀下的参数设为全局参数。

如需排除少数参数，可在这些参数名前添加 !。

entries.key: All parameters listed here that are found in FX controllers listed above will have their values smoothed. The duration represents how many seconds it should take to reach 90% of the target value.
entries.value: 平滑处理上方 FX 控制器中此列表内的参数。时长表示达到目标值 90% 所需的秒数。

entries.key: This allows you to rewrite the path to objects used in the animation clips of this controller. Useful if the animations in the controller were originally written to be based from a specific avatar root, but you are now trying to use as a re-usable VRCFury prop.
entries.value: 重写此控制器动画片段使用的对象路径。适用于最初基于某个角色根对象制作、现在需要作为通用 VRCFury 道具使用的动画。

entries.key: Inject values from other VRCFury components into this controller (or global if it's also marked as a global param)
entries.value: 将其他 VRCFury 组件提供的值注入此控制器；若同时标记为全局参数，也可注入全局参数。

entries.key: Force all synced parameters to be un-saved
entries.value: 强制所有同步参数不保存

entries.key: For Base, TPose, IKPose, and Sitting controllers, replace the avatar descriptor's existing controller of the same type instead of appending to it. Its layers will be placed above layers added by other Full Controllers in append mode. Uncheck to keep the existing controllers and append this controller's layers.
entries.value: 对于 Base、TPose、IKPose 和 Sitting，替换角色描述组件中的同类型控制器，而非追加图层。替换后的图层位于其他以追加模式合并的完整控制器图层之上。取消勾选则保留现有控制器并追加图层。

entries.key: Root bindings always apply to avatar (Basically only for gogoloco)
entries.value: 根路径绑定始终应用到角色（主要供 GogoLoco 使用）
（已弃用）将所有不同步参数设为全局参数

entries.key: (Deprecated) Don't fail if assets are missing
(Deprecated) Inject nearest SPS depth (use Inject Parameters instead)
entries.value: （已弃用）注入最近 SPS 深度（请改用“注入参数”）

entries.key: (Deprecated) Inject nearest SPS velocity (use Inject Parameters instead)
entries.value: （已弃用）注入最近 SPS 速度（请改用“注入参数”）

entries.key: This adds an editor gizmo to the current object. Informational only, no changes are made to the avatar.
entries.value: 为当前对象添加编辑器辅助图示，仅供查看，不会改动角色。

entries.key:
This component forces a VRC head chop on the current object to point to the avatar's head bone. The head chop component MUST contain only one source, and that source will be overwritten with the avatar's head.

This is basically only useful for GogoLoco.
entries.value:
将当前对象上的 VRC Head Chop 指向角色头骨骼。Head Chop 组件必须只有一个来源，该来源将被替换为角色头部。

此功能主要供 GogoLoco 使用。

entries.key: This feature will automatically convert all non-conflicting toggle layers into a single direct blend tree layer.
entries.value: 将互不冲突的开关图层自动转换到同一个直接混合树图层中。

entries.key: This component will improve MMD compatibility for your avatar, by maintaining MMD blendshapes and avoiding usage of layers that MMD worlds are known to interfere with.
entries.value: 保留 MMD 使用的形态键，并避免使用已知会受 MMD 世界干扰的图层，以改善角色的 MMD 兼容性。

entries.key: When MMD is detected, disable layers with these names:
entries.value: 检测到 MMD 时，禁用以下名称的图层：

entries.key: When MMD is detected, set this global bool to true:
entries.value: 检测到 MMD 时，将此全局布尔参数设为 true：

entries.key: This feature will move a menu item to another location. You can use slashes to make subfolders.
entries.value: 将菜单项移动到另一位置。可用斜杠创建子文件夹。

entries.key: This feature is deprecated and now does nothing. Use SPS instead! See vrcfury.com/sps
entries.value: 此功能已弃用，不再执行任何操作。请改用 SPS，详见 vrcfury.com/sps。

entries.key: This feature will disable blinking in the avatar's descriptor (setting eyelid type to None). This is useful if you are using a VRCFury blink controller on a base avatar, and want to disable their default blinking without messing with the stock files.
entries.value: 在角色描述组件中禁用眨眼，将眼睑类型设为 None。适用于用 VRCFury 眨眼控制器替代基础角色眨眼功能，同时保留原始文件。

entries.key: This feature will remove all usages of hand gestures within the avatar's default animator controllers. This is useful if you are using VRCFury to modify a base avatar, and want to disable their default gestures without messing with the stock controllers.
entries.value: 移除角色默认动画控制器中所有手势控制。适用于用 VRCFury 修改基础角色，并停用其默认手势，同时保留原始控制器文件。

entries.key: This feature will change the position of a menu item within its folder.
entries.value: 调整菜单项在其所在文件夹内的顺序。

entries.key:
This is the position that you want to move the menu item to.

Examples:
0 = 'First' (Top Right)
1 = 'Second'
4 = 'Fifth'
999 = 'Last' (Top Left)
-1 = 'Second-to-Last'
-2 = 'Third-to-Last'
etc
entries.value:
菜单项需要移动到的位置。

示例：
0 = 第一项（右上）
1 = 第二项
4 = 第五项
999 = 最后一项（左上）
-1 = 倒数第二项
-2 = 倒数第三项
依此类推。

entries.key:
This feature will add a `Security` submenu in your avatar's menu. Until the correct pin number is entered:
* All objects with a VRCFury Security Restricted component will be disabled.
* All VRCFury Toggles marked with the `Security` flag will be forced Off.
entries.value:
在角色菜单中添加 Security 子菜单。输入正确的 PIN 码前：
* 带有 VRCFury“安全限制”组件的对象会被禁用。
* 标记为“安全保护”的 VRCFury 开关会被强制关闭。

entries.key: Pin Number (min 4 digits, max 10 digits, can only use numbers 1-7)
entries.value: PIN 码（4 至 10 位，仅可使用数字 1–7）

entries.key: This object will be forcefully disabled until a Security Pin is entered in your avatar's menu.Note: You MUST have a Security Pin Number component on your avatar root with a pin number set, or this will not do anything!
entries.value: 在角色菜单中输入安全 PIN 码前，强制禁用此对象。注意：必须在角色根对象上添加“安全 PIN 码”组件并设置 PIN 码，否则此功能无效！

entries.key: This feature is designed to be used by Senky only. Implementation may change at any time. If you are not Senky, please use the 'Gesture' feature instead.
entries.value: 此功能仅供 Senky 使用，实现可能随时变更。其他用户请使用“手势”功能。

entries.key: This feature will override the menu icon for the given menu path. You can use slashes to look in subfolders.
entries.value: 覆盖指定菜单路径的图标。可用斜杠访问子文件夹。

entries.key:
This component will automatically make this GameObject a child of the head bone, and will use constraint tricks to make it visible in first person.

Warning:
* Do not combine this with armature link.
* First person objects cannot be attached to non-first-person objects, such as nose or ear bones.
* World position will be maintained when reparented.
entries.value:
自动将此对象移动为头骨骼的子对象，并使用约束使其在第一人称中可见。

注意：
* 不要与骨架联动同时使用。
* 第一人称对象不能连接到鼻骨、耳骨等非第一人称对象上。
* 更改父级时保留世界位置。

entries.key: This feature is deprecated and now does nothing. The slot 4 bug has been fixed in unity 2022.
entries.value: 此功能已弃用，不再执行任何操作。Unity 2022 已修复第 4 槽位问题。

entries.value: 角色说话时激活指定动画。

This should NEVER be used on vrcfury props, as any merged full controllers will have their parameters rewritten.

It is unusual to check this, but is required if you want this slider to interact with Exclusive Tags or transitions.

entries.key: The avatar will be like it is in the editor. You can override this with an Apply During Upload component.
entries.value: 角色保持编辑器中的状态。可用“上传时应用”组件覆盖该状态。

entries.key: Behaviour will return to the default
This is the Exclusive Off State

You cannot use Turn Off for an object that another Toggle Turns On! Turn Off should only be used for objects which are not controlled by their own toggle.

1. You do not need a dedicated 'Turn Off' toggle. Turning off the other toggle will turn off the object.

2. If you want this toggle to turn off the other toggle when activated, use Exclusive Tags instead (in the options on the top right).
entries.value:
不能对被其他开关“开启”的对象使用“关闭”动作！“关闭”仅应用于没有独立开关控制的对象。

1. 无需专门创建“关闭”开关，关闭原有开关就会关闭对象。

entries.key: This is where the menu will be merged into the avatar's existing menu. If the box is empty, it will be merged into the root of the avatar's menu. If you put (for example) 'Clothes', then the menu file will be placed within a submenu called 'Clothes'.
entries.value: 指定此菜单合并到角色现有菜单中的位置。留空时合并到菜单根目录；例如填写 Clothes，会将菜单放入名为 Clothes 的子菜单。

entries.key: This object is an avatar TEST COPY. Avatar preprocessors have already run on this object. Do not upload test copies, they are intended for temporary in-editor testing only. Attempting to upload this avatar may result in breakage, as all preprocessors will be run again. Any changes made to this copy will be lost.
entries.value: 此对象是角色测试副本，已经运行过角色预处理器。请勿上传：测试副本仅用于编辑器内的临时检查，再次上传会重复运行预处理器，可能导致异常。对此副本的修改将丢失。

entries.key: The given target field on an udon behaviour on this object will be automatically set during the upload to matching components in the scene.
entries.value: 上传时，将此对象 Udon 行为的指定目标字段自动设置为场景中匹配的组件。
